# onepix-fouriershift 0.1.3 (reference sources)

`PatternsCreation.py` and `ImageReconstruction.py` are the modules of
[onepix-fouriershift](https://pypi.org/project/onepix-fouriershift/) 0.1.3, as published,
before the single-sided mode. `fourier_single_sided_test.py` loads them to check that the
current plugin gives the same patterns and the same reconstruction when the mode is off.
The plugin is MIT licensed (`LICENSE`).
